title: VMware releases workarounds for
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-379.11.25.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – VMware Releases Workarounds for CVE-2020-4006
leadParagraph: VMware has released workarounds to address a vulnerability—CVE-2020-4006—in VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector.
contentHtml:
VMware has released workarounds to address a vulnerability—CVE-2020-4006—in VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector.

An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to take control of an affected system.

It is encouraged, users and administrators review VMware Security Advisory and apply the necessary workarounds.

For further information, please visit the link below:
VMSA-2020-0027
